data.name: Balaash
data.gender_notes: Balaash is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Balaash is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'Bala', which means power or strength. In Hindu mythology, Bala is an epithet of Lord Vishnu, signifying his ability to protect and provide strength to his devotees. The name Balaash carries the meaning “Power, Strength” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Balaash usually hope their child will grow to embody power, strength and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the inner power and courage that helps one overcome challenges and obstacles in life.
data.etymology: Balaash belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Power, Strength.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Balaash total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

historical_references.reference: Balaash was a renowned sage and poet in ancient India, particularly known for his work in the Sanskrit language. He was a contemporary of the great sage and philosopher Adi Shankara (788-820 AD). Balaash is believed to have composed several hymns and verses in the Shiva Purana and the Devi Mahatmya.

Another reference to Balaash can be found in the works of 13th century Kannada poet, Saint Vyasa Tirumulana. In these works, Balaash is mentioned as one of the 63 Nayanars – sacred saints in the Shaivite tradition of Hinduism, revered for their devotion to Lord Shiva.
